gates.name: test
gates.cmd: TODO: the command that runs your tests, e.g. make test
gates.fileCmd: TODO: the same runner for named test files, e.g. bun test (remove if cmd takes file arguments)

build: TODO: the commands the builder may run, e.g. make *
verify: TODO: the commands the verifier may run, e.g. make *

_postEditCommand: optional: argv run after each build edit, {file} is the path, e.g. ["bunx", "biome", "check", "--write", "--no-errors-on-unmatched", "{file}"]
_workflow: the steps an issue runs: .factory/workflows/<name>.yml, else the runner's copy of feature-to-pr
_tracker: where issues live: github, or {"kind": "http", "url": "https://tasks.example.com", "tokenEnv": "TRACKER_TOKEN"} for Tracker API v1
_labels: optional: the factory's label names to your team's, e.g. {"factory:ready": "ready-for-ai"}
